My dearest Sandora, how have you been?

Sorry it's taken me so long to write! It took a while to find a traveling merchant willing to carry this letter to you.

You miss me a lot, don't you? For the record, I'm doing great here!

I love being a Graveborn! I can run and jump without any trouble, and every day I get to do all the things I love. I'm happier now than I ever was when I was alive!

The only fly in the ointment is that I can no longer spend time with you.

Actually... death's not so bad, if you think about it. Just a reunion with everyone who got there first. Kind of takes the edge off, doesn't it? Haha.

Ah, enough gloomy talk about death! Guess what? I'm getting ready to move to a new place!

Point is, I'm living my best life here, so don't worry about me, okay?

Forever yours, Sabrine

P.S. My new address is <style="highlight">1, West Ossuary Square, Novaris</style>. There's a giant tree right next to my new home!

If we have the chance to meet again, be sure to come visit me!
document:11:624:0.source_cn:
嗨，我最最最亲爱的珊多拉，你最近还好吗？
真对不起，过了这么久才给你们来信。我找了好几个地方，才找到这个游商能给你们寄信。
你们是不是很想我？别担心，我一切都好！
亡灵的生活很幸福，在这里我能跑、能跳，每天都有很多时间干自己想做的事。我比活着的时候还开心！
唯一的遗憾，就是不能见到你们。
不过换个角度想一想，原本带来恐惧的死亡，其实是和家人的重逢……哈哈，这么一想，死亡是不是也没有那么可怕了？
算啦，先不说这个了！对了，我最近还准备搬去新家呢。
总之，我现在一切安好，大家放心吧！
——永远爱你们的，莎柏琳
顺便一提，我的新地址是<style="highlight">诺珐斯郡，称骨广场西街一号</style>。那里有一棵很高的树，旁边就是我的新家啦！
如果未来几十年后，我们有机会在这里重逢的话，记得来看看我哦！

say:2:1820115001:1.text: Welcome to my party, my friends!
say:2:1820115001:1.source_cn: 亲爱的朋友，欢迎你们参加忌日派对！

say:3:1820115002:0.text: There's still some time before the party officially kicks off. You can sign in here first, then have a look around!
say:3:1820115002:0.source_cn: 距离派对正式开始还有一段时间，你们可以先来这里签到，再...

say:5:1820115004:0.text: Ah, that's not me! Sabrine is over—
say:5:1820115004:0.source_cn: 哦，我当然不是！莎柏琳在——

say:2:1820117001:1.text: You look even more adorable than before, my darling! Come here and let me get a good look at you!
say:2:1820117001:1.source_cn: 我亲爱的薇薇娅，你比之前更可爱了！来来来，快让姨妈看看！

say:3:1820117002:1.source_cn: 莎、莎柏琳姨妈？你比我想得要更……

say:5:1820117004:0.text: Bet you didn't know—we Graveborn keep the appearance we had at the moment of death, forever. We never age!
say:5:1820117004:0.source_cn: 你们还不知道，亡灵的外表会永远保持着死亡时的年纪，不会...

say:6:1820117005:0.text: Now, Vivi, tell me—did you sneak your way here, or did you actually die?
say:6:1820117005:0.source_cn: 好了，先不说这个。薇薇娅，你先告诉我——你究竟是偷渡来...

say:7:1820117006:0.text: Relax, I'm still alive! I snuck in on a ship. This whole Graveborn look is just magic!
say:7:1820117006:0.source_cn: 姨妈，你放心吧，我是跟着船队一起过来的，没有真的死！这...

say:8:1820117007:1.text: Um... that's just me, though. My friend here just became a Graveborn.
say:8:1820117007:1.source_cn: 呃……不过，我身边这位朋友倒是真的刚死。

say:9:1820117008:1.text: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!
say:9:1820117008:1.source_cn: 原来是这样。亲爱的，恭喜新死！
say:9:1820117008:1.male: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!
say:9:1820117008:1.female: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!

say:10:1820117009:1.text: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
say:10:1820117009:1.source_cn: 一开始可能会有些不习惯。但放心吧，诺珐斯是个很好的地方...
say:10:1820117009:1.male: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
say:10:1820117009:1.female: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!

choice_prompt:11:1820117009.source_cn: 一开始可能会有些不习惯。但放心吧，诺珐斯是个很好的地方。在这里，死了绝对比活着更快活！

choice_prompt:11:1820117009.female: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!

say:12:1820117010:1.text: ... Oh, right! Speaking of which, who is this party for, Aunt Sabrine? I don't remember today being your death anniversary.
say:12:1820117010:1.source_cn: ……对了！说起来，姨妈，这里的忌日派对到底是怎么回事？...

say:13:1820117011:1.text: Today's celebration is for my new husband and our son.
say:13:1820117011:1.source_cn: 因为今天派对的主角不是我，而是我的新婚丈夫和儿子哦。

say:14:1820117012:1.text: They happened to pass away on the same day, so we decided to throw one big party for them both!
say:14:1820117012:1.source_cn: 他们两个的忌日恰巧是同一天呢，所以我们决定办一个隆重的...

say:15:1820117013:1.text: ... Hold on, your husband... and son?

say:16:1820117014:1.text: Aunt Sabrine, I thought you said marriage wasn't your thing!
say:16:1820117014:1.source_cn: 姨妈，你不是不愿意结婚吗？怎么死后不仅结了婚……还生了...

say:17:1820117015:1.text: My dear Vivi, don't be so surprised!
say:17:1820117015:1.source_cn: 薇薇娅，我亲爱的！不要这么惊讶。

say:18:1820117016:0.text: I said that back then mainly because I was sick... and hadn't met the right person yet.
say:18:1820117016:0.source_cn: 我生前不愿意结婚，主要是因为我的病，以及还没遇到合适的人。

say:19:1820117017:1.text: Now that I have endless time ahead of me, I'm ready to enjoy life and build a family with the man I love.
say:19:1820117017:1.source_cn: 死后，我有很长的时间来享受生活，以及做好和喜欢的人组建...

say:20:1820117018:1.text: Graveborn, of course, can't have children.
say:20:1820117018:1.source_cn: 至于我的儿子艾维斯……呵呵，亲爱的薇薇娅，亡灵当然是没...

say:21:1820117019:1.text: My husband and I adopted Elvens after an accident took his life. It's a common practice here in Novaris.
say:21:1820117019:1.source_cn: 艾维斯是我和丈夫一起领养来的，是一个在孩童时就意外死去...

say:23:1820117021:1.text: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.
say:23:1820117021:1.source_cn: 尽管薇薇娅竭力想表现出轻松的表情，但你看得出，她仍然无...
say:23:1820117021:1.male: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.
say:23:1820117021:1.female: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.

say:24:1820117022:1.text: Sabrine could see that as well.
say:24:1820117022:1.source_cn: 很明显，莎柏琳也看出了这一点。
say:24:1820117022:1.male: Sabrine could see that as well.
say:24:1820117022:1.female: Sabrine could see that as well.

say:25:1820117023:1.text: The party won't start until later. Why don't I show you around the city in the meantime?
say:25:1820117023:1.source_cn: 距离派对开始还要一点时间呢，不如我带你们在城里四处逛逛吧？

say:26:1820117024:1.text: I have to show you what my life is like here, Vivi!
say:26:1820117024:1.source_cn: 一方面，是让我们的小薇薇娅能安心点——

say:27:1820117025:1.text: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!
say:27:1820117025:1.source_cn: 另一方面，也让这位新亡的朋友熟悉、适应一下这里。
say:27:1820117025:1.male: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!
say:27:1820117025:1.female: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!

say:28:1820117026:1.text: Let's check out the market here!
say:28:1820117026:1.source_cn: 那……我想去一趟这里的集市！

say:29:1820117027:1.text: A death anniversary party... It's basically like a birthday party, right?
say:29:1820117027:1.source_cn: 虽然我还不太理解忌日派对……但这肯定是和生日派对一样，...

say:30:1820117028:1.text: It's bad form to show up to a party empty-handed! Hopefully, I'll find a nice gift at the market.
say:30:1820117028:1.source_cn: 既然要参加派对，就不能空手来！我想去集市看看有没有合适...

say:31:1820117029:1.text: Oh, Vivi... You're always so sweet!
say:31:1820117029:1.source_cn: 我可爱的小薇薇娅……你还是那么贴心！

say:32:1820117030:1.text: There's a market nearby with stalls selling all sorts of fun little knickknacks. We can head there!
say:32:1820117030:1.source_cn: 这附近有一处集市，里面经常会卖些新奇有趣的小玩意。我们...

choice:11:1:2.text: I can tell you're having a great time here.
choice:11:1:2.male: I can tell you're having a great time here.
choice:11:1:2.female: I can tell you're having a great time here.

choice:11:2:3.text: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 你们甚至在办忌日派对
choice:11:2:3.male: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.
choice:11:2:3.female: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.

say:0:1820125001:0.text: Aunt Sabrine seems really fond of the tea set, but it's a bit pricey... Guess I'll buy less merch. I'll take it!
say:0:1820125001:0.source_cn: 姨妈好像很喜欢这套茶具。虽然价格有点……嗯……算了，少...

say:3:1820126002:1.text: ... Yes, I'll take it! How much is it?
say:3:1820126002:1.source_cn: ……是的，我想买下这套茶具！请问多少钱？

say:4:1820126003:1.text: <style="highlight">30 Mortimers</style>, or the <style="highlight">equivalent in Bantus iron</style>.

say:5:1820126004:1.text: Um, how much in Lightbearer gold?
say:5:1820126004:1.source_cn: 呃，请问换成耀光的金币要多少？

say:6:1820126005:1.text: Gold? I only take Mortimers or Bantus iron.
say:6:1820126005:1.source_cn: 耀光？我不收这种活人的钱。只收莫蒂默银币和班题斯黑铁币。

say:7:1820126006:1.text: ... Wait, what? I only have gold on me...
say:7:1820126006:1.source_cn: ……啊？怎么这样？但我只带了金币……

say:8:1820126007:1.text: Young lady, shouldn't you have at least looked into what currency we use here before sneaking your way in?
say:8:1820126007:1.source_cn: 小朋友，你都选择了偷渡，不应该事先了解一下这里流通的货币吗？

say:9:1820126008:1.text: The guy who got me here told me I could use gold in Novaris.
say:9:1820126008:1.source_cn: 负责偷渡的人和我说过，在诺珐斯也可以用耀光金币！

say:10:1820126009:1.text: Are you sure gold isn't accepted here?
say:10:1820126009:1.source_cn: 老板，你是不是哪里弄错了？

say:11:1820126010:1.text: Whoever told you that left out one important detail.

say:12:1820126011:1.text: Sure, some merchants here do take your money because stowaways like you are their bread and butter.
say:12:1820126011:1.source_cn: 这里的确有人收活人的钱，但都是那些都是专做偷渡者生意的。

say:13:1820126012:1.text: As for me, I'm just running a small business here. I can't afford to have Bantus breathing down my neck.
say:13:1820126012:1.source_cn: 我就是做个小本买卖，没那个本钱。

say:15:1820126014:1.text: Trust me, I'm a serious buyer!
say:15:1820126014:1.source_cn: 老板，我是诚心想要的！您不是也说我的眼光很好吗？

say:16:1820126015:1.text: And I can tell you truly love your own work.
say:16:1820126015:1.source_cn: 我看得出，您肯定是真心喜欢自己的作品的！

say:17:1820126016:1.text: Plenty of people may be able to afford your tea set, but not everyone would appreciate it the way I do.
say:17:1820126016:1.source_cn: 您难道要错过我这个有品鉴能力、有眼光、爱惜您作品的客人...

say:18:1820126017:1.text: Th-They'd buy it and let it gather dust at home!
say:18:1820126017:1.source_cn: 我……我认为，那些人肯定不会像我这样珍惜您的茶具！

say:20:1820126019:1.text: Haha, you're quite the character, young lady! All right, the tea set is yours!
say:20:1820126019:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你这个活人小姑娘还真有意思！好吧，我卖给你了！

say:21:1820126020:1.text: But as I said, I only accept Mortimers or Bantus iron.
say:21:1820126020:1.source_cn: 不过——还是那句话，我只收莫蒂默银币和班题斯黑铁币。

say:22:1820126021:1.text: I'll hold the tea set for you while you find somewhere to exchange your currency.
say:22:1820126021:1.source_cn: 但你可以去附近的旅店兑换货币，我就在这里等你，帮你留着...

say:23:1820126022:1.text: Don't forget to use this passphrase for the transaction: "I'd like to book Room 1147."
say:23:1820126022:1.source_cn: 记住，兑换时记得说暗号：“我要住1147号房”。

say:24:1820126023:1.text: Why all the secrecy, you ask? Well, Bantus officially bans the circulation of gold.
say:24:1820126023:1.source_cn: 明面上，班题斯是不允许流通金币的。只有答对了暗号才能换钱。

say:25:1820126024:1.text: Got it! Just make sure you keep that tea set for me!
say:25:1820126024:1.source_cn: 好，我这就去！您可千万别卖给别人啊！

say:2:1820128001:0.text: There's an inn nearby that offers currency exchange... I'm on my way there now!
say:2:1820128001:0.source_cn: 原来这里的旅店可以换钱……好，我这就出发！

say:3:1820128002:0.text: Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be right back!
say:3:1820128002:0.male: Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be right back!
say:3:1820128002:0.female: Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be right back!

say:4:1820128003:0.text: My dear Vivi, it's the thought that counts. You don't have to splurge on that tea set for me.
say:4:1820128003:0.source_cn: 薇薇娅，亲爱的，你的心意姨妈已经心领了，别破费买那茶具了。

say:5:1820128004:0.text: Besides, the gold exchange rate here is awful. You shouldn't be throwing your money around like that...
say:5:1820128004:0.source_cn: 活人金币换成钱的汇率很不值，你一个人出门在外，用钱还是...

say:6:1820128005:1.text: Aunt Sabrine, say no more! I'm getting this tea set today, no matter what!
say:6:1820128005:1.source_cn: 哎呀姨妈，你就别管了！这个茶具我今天一定要买下！

say:7:1820128006:1.text: I'm heading to that inn now. Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, just wait here for me!

say:7:1820128006:1.male: I'm heading to that inn now. Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, just wait here for me!
say:7:1820128006:1.female: I'm heading to that inn now. Aunt Sabrine and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, just wait here for me!

say:8:1820128007:1.text: Oh, and make sure you keep an eye on that tea set. Don't let anyone else buy it before I do!
say:8:1820128007:1.source_cn: 对了，一定帮我看住那套茶具，千万别被别人抢先买走了！

narration:9:1820128008:0.text: Vivi hurries off before either of you can say anything further...
narration:9:1820128008:0.source_cn: 不等你们回答，薇薇娅已经风风火火地跑去了旅店……
narration:9:1820128008:0.male: Vivi hurries off before either of you can say anything further...
narration:9:1820128008:0.female: Vivi hurries off before either of you can say anything further...

say:0:1820129001:0.source_cn: 唉，这孩子真是一点没变……

choice_prompt:11:1820130009.source_cn: 薇薇娅也说过，她已经在诺珐斯住了一段时间。或许她会知道一些有关艾雅的线索……
choice_prompt:11:1820130009.male: According to Vivi, she's been living in Novaris for quite a while now. There's a chance she might know something about Dura...
choice_prompt:11:1820130009.female: According to Vivi, she's been living in Novaris for quite a while now. There's a chance she might know something about Dura...

say:13:1820130010:1.text: Oh, my darling... that's too profound a question. Even with an eternity before us, a Graveborn could never truly grasp Dura's existence.
say:13:1820130010:1.source_cn: 哦，亲爱的……原来令你忧心的是这样宏大的疑问。一个亡灵...
say:13:1820130010:1.male: Oh, my darling... that's too profound a question. Even with an eternity before us, a Graveborn could never truly grasp Dura's existence.
say:13:1820130010:1.female: Oh, my darling... that's too profound a question. Even with an eternity before us, a Graveborn could never truly grasp Dura's existence.

say:14:1820130011:1.text: This is only my first decade in Novaris, so I'm not too familiar with the local folklore.
say:14:1820130011:1.source_cn: 我刚刚去世十年，对于诺珐斯当地传闻不太清楚。
say:14:1820130011:1.male: This is only my first decade in Novaris, so I'm not too familiar with the local folklore.
say:14:1820130011:1.female: This is only my first decade in Novaris, so I'm not too familiar with the local folklore.

say:15:1820130012:0.text: The only rumor I've heard is that Dura was seen in Novaris before she went missing during the Second Divine War.
say:15:1820130012:0.source_cn: 只听说过，在第二次神魔大战期间，耀光也曾有传言，艾雅女...
say:15:1820130012:0.male: The only rumor I've heard is that Dura was seen in Novaris before she went missing during the Second Divine War.
say:15:1820130012:0.female: The only rumor I've heard is that Dura was seen in Novaris before she went missing during the Second Divine War.

say:18:1820130014:1.text: The rumor spread through Novaris back then, but no one had actually seen the goddess. It's a mystery how it started.
say:18:1820130014:1.source_cn: 那时诺珐斯也流传过这种说法。但根本没人亲眼见到那位神，...

choice_prompt:19:1820130014.text: The rumor spread through Novaris back then, but no one had actually seen the goddess. It's a mystery how it started.
choice_prompt:19:1820130014.source_cn: 那时诺珐斯也流传过这种说法。但根本没人亲眼见到那位神，不知道是怎么传出来的谣言。

say:20:1820130015:1.text: Young man, don't look so down!
say:20:1820130015:1.source_cn: 好了，年轻的亡灵，不要露出这么失落的表情。
say:20:1820130015:1.male: Young man, don't look so down!
say:20:1820130015:1.female: Young lady, don't look so down!

say:21:1820130016:1.text: Whatever you believed in while you were alive, it no longer matters. Once you've died, you come to realize that life is fleeting, while only death is eternal.
say:21:1820130016:1.source_cn: 不必过于在意生前的信仰。死了就会明白，生命终会消逝，唯...
say:21:1820130016:1.male: Whatever you believed in while you were alive, it no longer matters. Once you've died, you come to realize that life is fleeting, while only death is eternal.
say:21:1820130016:1.female: Whatever you believed in while you were alive, it no longer matters. Once you've died, you come to realize that life is fleeting, while only death is eternal.

say:22:1820130017:1.text: Against that backdrop, the whereabouts of the Goddess of Life no longer hold any significance.
say:22:1820130017:1.source_cn: 既然如此，生命女神的失踪又算得了什么呢？
say:22:1820130017:1.male: Against that backdrop, the whereabouts of the Goddess of Life no longer hold any significance.
say:22:1820130017:1.female: Against that backdrop, the whereabouts of the Goddess of Life no longer hold any significance.

say:23:1820130018:1.text: Don't worry, time will enlighten you. You'll leave your old beliefs behind before you know it.
say:23:1820130018:1.source_cn: 当时间终于教会你这一点时，你就不必再被生前的虔信折磨了。
say:23:1820130018:1.male: Don't worry, time will enlighten you. You'll leave your old beliefs behind before you know it.
say:23:1820130018:1.female: Don't worry, time will enlighten you. You'll leave your old beliefs behind before you know it.

choice:11:0:1.text: Do you know anything about Dura's whereabouts?
choice:11:0:1.male: Do you know anything about Dura's whereabouts?
choice:11:0:1.female: Do you know anything about Dura's whereabouts?

choice:5:1:2.text: As a freshie, there's only so much I can do.
choice:5:1:2.male: As a freshie, there's only so much I can do.
choice:5:1:2.female: As a freshie, there's only so much I can do.

say:0:1820131001:0.text: What have you been discussing? You all look so serious.
say:0:1820131001:0.source_cn: 你们在聊什么呢，怎么都表情都这么严肃？

say:2:1820132001:1.text: That inn owner's such a scammer...
say:2:1820132001:1.source_cn: 呜呜，诺珐斯的旅店商人好黑……

say:3:1820132002:1.text: What happened? Did he pick on you? I swear I'll tear his arm off...
say:3:1820132002:1.source_cn: 怎么，他敢欺负你吗？等着，姨妈现在就去把他的胳膊掰下来——

say:4:1820132003:1.text: No, he didn't... He offered the same rate to everyone.
say:4:1820132003:1.source_cn: ——不不不，他没有欺负我！他给所有人的汇率都是一样的。

say:5:1820132004:1.text: But that rate? Practically daylight robbery! Someone tried to haggle with him, and he had the nerve to insist it was fair! He said the tavern next door was the real scam!
say:5:1820132004:1.source_cn: 但他给出的汇率实在高得吓人！有人想讲讲价，那个商人还大...

say:6:1820132005:1.text: Some customers weren't buying it and marched straight to the tavern at the end of Crescent Street to see what they were charging.
say:6:1820132005:1.source_cn: 有人不服，当场就打算去月弯街尽头的那个酒馆问问价。

say:7:1820132006:1.text: I'd have joined them if I didn't need to rush back...
say:7:1820132006:1.source_cn: 要不是我赶时间，非得跟着他们一起去一趟……

say:8:1820132007:1.text: Vivi, you'd better stay away from that tavern.
say:8:1820132007:1.source_cn: 薇薇娅，不要随便去那个酒馆哦。

say:9:1820132008:1.text: The living frequent that area, and the tavern even openly accepts Lightbearer gold.
say:9:1820132008:1.source_cn: 那附近常有活人出没，酒馆甚至可以正当光明地使用耀光金币。

say:10:1820132009:1.text: Yet, Bantus never takes action against it. That place has to be backed by some powerful force we don't know about.
say:10:1820132009:1.source_cn: 如此毫不遮掩，班题斯却从不管。那地方不简单，肯定背靠着...

say:11:1820132010:1.text: Promise me you'll steer clear of it while you're in Novaris, alright, my dear Vivi?
say:11:1820132010:1.source_cn: 在诺珐斯期间，一定要尽量避开那个地方。记住了吗，我亲爱...

say:13:1820132012:1.text: Anyway, I've got enough iron for that tea set now!
say:13:1820132012:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，我已经换到了足够的黑铁币了。老板，请帮我把...

say:15:1820132014:1.text: The party doesn't begin until the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises, so we still have time to visit other places.

say:0:1820133001:0.text: We can keep looking around! The party doesn't begin until the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises.
say:0:1820133001:0.male: We can keep looking around! The party doesn't begin until the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises.
say:0:1820133001:0.female: We can keep looking around! The party doesn't begin until the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises.

narration:0:1820134001:1.text: You wander the area, chatting along the way as the hours slip by.
narration:0:1820134001:1.male: You wander the area, chatting along the way as the hours slip by.
narration:0:1820134001:1.female: You wander the area, chatting along the way as the hours slip by.

narration:1:1820134002:1.text: As a gentle breeze stirs, the drifting clouds part to reveal the luminous full moon...

say:0:1820135001:0.text: The party's about to begin. Let's head back!
say:0:1820135001:0.source_cn: 派对就要开始了，我们回家吧！
say:0:1820135001:0.male: The party's about to begin. Let's head back!
say:0:1820135001:0.female: The party's about to begin. Let's head back!

narration:0:1820136001:0.text: By the time you return to Sabrine's place, all the decorations are in place.
narration:0:1820136001:0.source_cn: 当你们回到莎柏琳家时，忌日派对的布置已经完成
narration:0:1820136001:0.male: By the time you return to Sabrine's place, all the decorations are in place.
narration:0:1820136001:0.female: By the time you return to Sabrine's place, all the decorations are in place.

say:3:1820136002:1.text: Sabrine, there you are! Where have you been? We were starting to think you'd gone back to being alive!
say:3:1820136002:1.source_cn: 莎柏琳！你总算回来了。一直找不到你，我们还以为你不小心...

say:4:1820136003:0.text: Come on inside! Murray and Elvens are waiting for you.
say:4:1820136003:0.source_cn: 快进来吧，莫雷和小艾维斯都在等你呢！

say:0:1820137001:0.text: You follow Sabrine's friend into the house. The moment you step inside, the Graveborn enthusiastically welcome you.
say:0:1820137001:0.source_cn: 你们跟随莎柏琳的朋友进入了主屋。刹那间欢声笑语涌入耳中...
say:0:1820137001:0.male: You follow Sabrine's friend into the house. The moment you step inside, the Graveborn enthusiastically welcome you.
say:0:1820137001:0.female: You follow Sabrine's friend into the house. The moment you step inside, the Graveborn enthusiastically welcome you.

say:1:1820137002:0.text: The house is adorned with vibrant streamers, blooming flowers, and banners bearing heartfelt wishes... Moonlight filtering through the windows bathes them in a soft silvery glow.
say:1:1820137002:0.source_cn: 亮丽的彩带、美丽的花朵、写着祝福语的横幅……窗外漏入的...
say:1:1820137002:0.male: The house is adorned with vibrant streamers, blooming flowers, and banners bearing heartfelt wishes... Moonlight filtering through the windows bathes them in a soft silvery glow.
say:1:1820137002:0.female: The house is adorned with vibrant streamers, blooming flowers, and banners bearing heartfelt wishes... Moonlight filtering through the windows bathes them in a soft silvery glow.

say:2:1820137003:0.text: The party is every bit as lively as any celebration in the world of the living.
say:2:1820137003:0.source_cn: 尽管习俗装饰与生者世界的派对大不一样，但轻松的氛围、欢...
say:2:1820137003:0.male: The party is every bit as lively as any celebration in the world of the living.
say:2:1820137003:0.female: The party is every bit as lively as any celebration in the world of the living.

say:3:1820137004:0.text: In the warm atmosphere, you find yourself relaxing for the first time in ages...
say:3:1820137004:0.source_cn: 沉浸在这样的环境中，你久违地感受到了一丝放松……
say:3:1820137004:0.male: In the warm atmosphere, you find yourself relaxing for the first time in ages...
say:3:1820137004:0.female: In the warm atmosphere, you find yourself relaxing for the first time in ages...

say:5:1820137005:0.text: ... Wow... this party's nothing like I imagined.
say:5:1820137005:0.source_cn: ……哇……这个派对和我想象中的不太一样。

say:6:1820137006:0.text: It's more heartwarming and... intimate than I thought. It reminds me of my own birthday parties.
say:6:1820137006:0.source_cn: 它比我想得更温馨，更……亲切。和我的生日派对有点像。

say:7:1820137007:0.text: Why would you think it'd be any different, my dear?

say:8:1820137008:0.text: Dead or alive, we're still the same at heart. Life and death are merely different states of existence.
say:8:1820137008:0.source_cn: 我们的本质都是一样的。生或是死，不过是状态的更替，并未...

say:9:1820137009:0.text: Come, Vivi. I'd like you to meet my husband and son.
say:9:1820137009:0.source_cn: 来吧，薇薇娅。我为你介绍一下我的丈夫和孩子。

say:10:1820137010:0.text: Murray! Elvens! Could you come over for a moment? This is my niece, Vivi!
say:10:1820137010:0.source_cn: 莫雷，艾维斯！在这里！这是我的外甥女，薇薇娅。

say:11:1820137011:0.text: And this is her friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's a freshie, and he's still finding his feet in Novaris.
say:11:1820137011:0.male: And this is her friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's a freshie, and he's still finding his feet in Novaris.
say:11:1820137011:0.female: And this is her friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. She's a freshie, and she's still finding her feet in Novaris.

say:14:1820137012:0.text: Vivi and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a pleasure to meet you both.
say:14:1820137012:0.male: Vivi and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a pleasure to meet you both.
say:14:1820137012:0.female: Vivi and <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a pleasure to meet you both.

say:16:1820137014:0.text: Murray... and Elvens. It's so nice to finally put faces to the names! Um... wishing you...
say:16:1820137014:0.source_cn: 莫雷……姨夫，还有小艾维斯，你们好啊！祝你们，嗯……

choice_prompt:17:1820137014.text: Murray... and Elvens. It's so nice to finally put faces to the names! Um... wishing you...
choice_prompt:17:1820137014.source_cn: 莫雷……姨夫，还有小艾维斯，你们好啊！祝你们，嗯……

say:22:1820137017:0.text: Vivi, you must be curious how Murray and I met and fell in love, aren't you?
say:22:1820137017:0.source_cn: 薇薇娅，你是不是很好奇我是怎么和莫雷相识相爱的？

say:23:1820137018:0.text: You should remember that I enjoy writing poetry.
say:23:1820137018:0.source_cn: 或许你还记得，我有个写诗的爱好。

say:24:1820137019:0.text: Of course! I love the ones you wrote for me when I was little. They were all about fairy tales.
say:24:1820137019:0.source_cn: 我当然记得！你给我写过好多童话诗，我最喜欢听了。

say:25:1820137020:0.text: You always said you'd publish a poetry collection someday, so that those stories could reach more people.
say:25:1820137020:0.source_cn: 你还说，你要出一本诗集，让其他国家的人也能听到那些故事。

say:26:1820137021:0.text: That's right! You're really my biggest fan among the living, Vivi!
say:26:1820137021:0.source_cn: 没错！没想到你还记得这件事。果然在活着的人里，薇薇娅是...

say:27:1820137022:0.text: Back then, I had only just begun working on it when I was hospitalized.
say:27:1820137022:0.source_cn: 只可惜，我才写了个开头，就住进了医院，不得不停了下来。

say:28:1820137023:0.text: Becoming a Graveborn gave me the chance to carry on with my work. Maybe even the God of Death didn't want me to give up.
say:28:1820137023:0.source_cn: 或许是死神也想让我把那本诗集写完吧？我成为了亡灵，有了...

say:29:1820137024:0.text: And here in Novaris, I met another fan.
say:29:1820137024:0.source_cn: 不仅如此，我还遇到了一位新的读者呢。

say:30:1820137025:0.text: I've always loved literature, but life kept me too busy to devote much time to reading. It wasn't until after my death that I could finally immerse myself in it.
say:30:1820137025:0.source_cn: 我其实一直很喜欢文学作品，可惜生前一直为了生意忙碌，在...

say:31:1820137026:0.text: Over the years, I've read countless works by other Graveborn, but only Sabrine's poetry has truly captivated me.
say:31:1820137026:0.source_cn: 死去多年，我阅读了无数亡灵的作品。但唯独只有莎柏琳的诗...

say:32:1820137027:0.text: In her masterful imagery and the emotion she weaves into every line, I see everything I have always strived for.
say:32:1820137027:0.source_cn: 无论是她选取意象时展现的才华，还是那些词句中潜藏的情感...

say:33:1820137028:0.text: I never thought I'd find someone who understands me so well after I died. How lucky am I!
say:33:1820137028:0.source_cn: 我也没想到死后还能遇到这么懂我的读者，真是太幸运了！

say:34:1820137029:0.text: Maybe all those years of being sick were fate saving up my good luck for now.
say:34:1820137029:0.source_cn: 说不定，生前我生了那么多病，就是在为现在积攒运气呢。

say:35:1820137030:0.text: How could I let someone like that slip away? So, I married him!
say:35:1820137030:0.source_cn: 好不容易遇到这么合适的读者，怎么能轻易放过呢？于是——...

say:36:1820137031:0.text: One happy thing led to another, and before long, we met little Elvens. By the way, he's a big fan of my poems too!
say:36:1820137031:0.source_cn: 幸福的事接二连三。我们还认识了可爱的小艾维斯——顺便一...

say:39:1820137032:0.text: Yep! I made comic strips about those fairy tale characters!
say:39:1820137032:0.source_cn: 嗯！我还给那些角色画了连环画！

say:40:1820137033:0.text: Elvens here is the most talented artist in Novaris!
say:40:1820137033:0.source_cn: 哈哈，小艾维斯是诺珐斯最棒的小画家！

say:41:1820137034:0.text: Honey, remember the tea-loving queen from the fairy tale? You said you wanted a tea set just like hers, didn't you?
say:41:1820137034:0.source_cn: 对了，还记得童话里，那位很喜欢喝茶的女王陛下吗？你说也...

say:42:1820137035:0.text: Look what Vivi bought for you!
say:42:1820137035:0.source_cn: ——瞧，你的薇薇娅姐姐给你买了什么？

say:43:1820137036:1.text: Wow, this tea set is so pretty... It's exactly how I pictured the queen's tea set!
say:43:1820137036:1.source_cn: 哇！好漂亮的茶具……和我想象中的一模一样！

say:47:1820137038:0.text: It's just a little something for the two of you! Happy death anniversary!
say:47:1820137038:0.source_cn: 这是我送给你们的礼物。祝你们……祝你们忌日快乐！

say:48:1820137039:1.text: What a lovely gift. We love it!
say:48:1820137039:1.source_cn: 太感谢了，这套茶具真美，我们都很喜欢。

say:51:1820137040:1.text: Vivi, your visit means a great deal to Sabrine. After all, we Graveborn rarely get the chance to reunite with our families.
say:51:1820137040:1.source_cn: 感谢你来看望莎柏琳。对于亡灵来说，能与生前的亲人相聚就...

say:52:1820137041:0.text: Having you here is the best surprise we could have asked for.
say:52:1820137041:0.source_cn: 你的到来，本身就是这次忌日派对最大的惊喜。

say:53:1820137042:0.text: So, as our way of saying thank you, Murray and I would like to perform a poem we wrote together!
say:53:1820137042:0.source_cn: 为了表示感谢，我特意加了一个小小的节目哦。那就是……向...

say:54:1820137043:0.text: My dear Vivi, be my audience once again, just like old times.
say:54:1820137043:0.source_cn: 我亲爱的小薇薇娅，就像以前那样，再听我念一次自己的诗吧。

narration:55:1820137044:0.text: After a chorus of applause, Sabrine and Murray begin the recitation.
narration:55:1820137044:0.source_cn: 在掌声中，莎柏琳与莫雷念诵着合写的诗歌

narration:56:1820137045:0.text: As the poem nears its end, Sabrine lowers the manuscript and looks at Vivi with gentle affection.
narration:56:1820137045:0.source_cn: 直到最后几句，她忽然放下了手中的诗稿，温柔地望向薇薇娅

narration:57:1820137046:0.text: The fallen blossoms whisper to the weeping bird...
narration:57:1820137046:0.source_cn: 诗歌中凋落的花儿，对着那垂泪的鸟轻轻开口……

say:60:1820137047:0.text: Please send me off with joyful cheer,
say:60:1820137047:0.source_cn: 请用欢声笑语为我送行

say:61:1820137048:0.text: As my torment ends right here.
say:61:1820137048:0.source_cn: 庆贺我从枯萎的煎熬中离开

say:62:1820137049:0.text: With all your love, I journey home,

say:63:1820137050:0.text: So grieve me not when I am gone.
say:63:1820137050:0.source_cn: 所以，请不要为我的死亡哭泣

say:64:1820137051:0.text: Rejoice instead, for I am finally free.
say:64:1820137051:0.source_cn: 而要为我的解脱而欢庆

narration:65:1820137052:0.text: Meanwhile, Vivi is uncharacteristically quiet. You notice tears streaming down her face.
narration:65:1820137052:0.source_cn: 你身侧的薇薇娅陷入了罕见的沉默，默默落下了泪水
narration:65:1820137052:0.male: Meanwhile, Vivi is uncharacteristically quiet. You notice tears streaming down her face.
narration:65:1820137052:0.female: Meanwhile, Vivi is uncharacteristically quiet. You notice tears streaming down her face.

narration:66:1820137053:0.text: Obviously, she understands what the poem is trying to say...
narration:66:1820137053:0.source_cn: 你知道，她也听懂了诗歌的含义……
narration:66:1820137053:0.male: Obviously, she understands what the poem is trying to say...
narration:66:1820137053:0.female: Obviously, she understands what the poem is trying to say...

narration:67:1820137054:0.text: "... Vivi, believe me, I'm truly happy now."

narration:68:1820137055:0.text: The poem ends to thunderous applause from the guests. At long last, Vivi's worries for her aunt are finally put to rest...
